title: Words for an erase whose phone copy could not be removed (the S54 residual)
evidence: After an erase the cloud took, the erased record could not be written to the phone twice and the phone file could not be removed twice (ios/engine/cloud.ts keepErasedOnPhone): a pre-erase copy may stay on this iPhone, and the app says nothing. Drafted sentence for Brad's yes: 'This iPhone's copy could not be erased. Open the app with <cloud> connected to finish.' The engine cannot see whether a remove worked (phoneRemove is a Void native over try? removeItem), so it would read the phone file back after the second remove. The words could ride the erase result's existing warning field, which builds 11 and 12 already append to the erase-done text (DataEraser.swift:201, EraseText.swift:51), so no Swift build may be needed; that is part of the ruling. Until then the residual ends as it does today. Pinned: ios/engine/cloud.test.ts 'lead S54 residual (words: lead S61)'.
